name: deck-body-subset
body: Deck bodies use exactly the allowed Markdown subset (markdown-allowed-subset): paragraphs, `##` and `###` subheadings, single-level bulleted and numbered lists, and the inline set (bold, italic, inline code, `[]()` links, hard line breaks). Every construct outside that subset is refused with file/line and guidance: images, tables, blockquotes, fenced or indented code (except the section-frontmatter fence), horizontal rules, raw HTML, angle-bracket autolinks, GFM/other extensions (strikethrough, highlight, sup/sub, emoji shortcodes), `####`+ headings, and lists nested deeper than one level.
